mapper.select: SELECT community_seq as commuSeq, content, reg_date as regDate, heartrate, temperature, bloodpress, smoking, drinking, exercise, age, user_id as userId, user_nm as userNm, body_age as bodyAge, user_seq as userSeq, category FROM health_community WHERE community_seq = #{commuSeq}

SELECT community_seq as commuSeq, content, reg_date as regDate, heartrate, temperature, bloodpress, smoking, drinking, exercise, age, user_id as userId, user_nm as userNm, body_age as bodyAge, user_seq as userSeq, category FROM health_community WHERE 1=1
AND age / 10 = #{age} / 10
AND content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY reg_date DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageIdx} * #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE health_community SET content = #{content}, heartrate = #{heartrate}, temperature = #{temperature}, bloodpress = #{bloodpress}, smoking = #{smoking}, drinking = #{drinking}, exercise = #{exercise}, age = #{age}, body_age = #{bodyAge} WHERE community_seq = #{commuSeq}
